ent-wang-zheng-min.title: Academician, Chinese Academy of Sciences
ent-wang-zheng-min.authority: Academician of the Chinese Academy of Sciences; principal founder and pioneer of modern ear and lateral skull base microsurgery in China; a flagship figure in otorhinolaryngology–head and neck surgery.
ent-wang-zheng-min.focus: Middle ear and lateral skull base surgery, otomicrosurgery, cochlear implants, hearing reconstruction.
ent-wang-zheng-min.achievement: First in China to perform tympanoplasty for cholesteatomatous otitis media and microsurgical laser stapedotomy; created China's precision middle ear surgery and lateral skull base surgery systems.
ent-wang-zheng-min.honors: National Science and Technology Progress Award; Ho Leung Ho Lee Foundation Science and Technology Progress Award.

ent-zhou-bing.achievement: Endoscopic sinus and endoscopic skull base surgery.
ent-zhou-bing.honors: Research on nasal skull base surgery.

ent-li-hua-wei.achievement: Otomicrosurgery, hearing reconstruction and cochlear implantation.

ent-fang-ju-gao.achievement: Head and neck tumour resection and functional reconstruction.
ent-fang-ju-gao.honors: Research on head and neck tumours.

ent-liu-ming.honors: Research on prevention and treatment of hearing loss.

ent-han-de-min.focus: Otorhinolaryngology–head and neck surgery, cochlear implants, rhinology.

psychiatry-lu-lin.title: Academician, Chinese Academy of Sciences
psychiatry-lu-lin.authority: Academician of the Chinese Academy of Sciences; president of Peking University Sixth Hospital; director of the National Clinical Research Center for Mental Disorders; a leader in psychiatry and sleep medicine in China.
psychiatry-lu-lin.focus: Sleep disorders, depression, anxiety disorders, addiction medicine, neurobiology of psychiatric disorders.
psychiatry-lu-lin.achievement: Systematic advances in the neurobiology of sleep disorders and addiction; advanced the development of China's mental health service system.
psychiatry-lu-lin.honors: National Natural Science Award (Second Class); Ho Leung Ho Lee Foundation Science and Technology Progress Award.

psychiatry-ma-hong.achievement: Psychiatric rehabilitation, crisis intervention and post-disaster psychological assistance.

psychiatry-wang-zhen.achievement: Clinical research on anxiety disorders and obsessive-compulsive disorder.

psychiatry-zhang-wei-hua.achievement: Diagnosis and treatment of depressive and sleep disorders.

tcm-li-dian-gui.title: National TCM Master (Guoyi Dashi)
tcm-li-dian-gui.authority: National TCM Master and nationally renowned TCM physician; originator of the turbid-toxin theory; honorary chair of the Spleen and Stomach Disease Branch of the China Association of Chinese Medicine.
tcm-li-dian-gui.focus: Chronic atrophic gastritis, gastric precancerous lesions, cirrhosis, spleen and stomach disorders.
tcm-li-dian-gui.achievement: Developed the turbid-toxin theory and detoxifying therapy, significantly improving the reversal rate of gastric precancerous lesions; work recognised with a National Science and Technology Progress Award (Second Class).
tcm-li-dian-gui.honors: National TCM Master; National Science and Technology Progress Award (Second Class); National Outstanding Contribution Award for Traditional Chinese Medicine.

tcm-tong-xiao-lin.title: Academician, Chinese Academy of Sciences
tcm-tong-xiao-lin.achievement: Proposed state-target differentiation and treatment; developed the sugar-collateral disease theory of diabetes and TCM intervention protocols.
tcm-tong-xiao-lin.honors: TCM intervention and evidence-based research in diabetes.

tcm-zhang-bo-li.title: Academician, Chinese Academy of Engineering
tcm-zhang-bo-li.achievement: TCM in cardiovascular prevention and in controlling major epidemics.
tcm-zhang-bo-li.honors: Research on TCM for major diseases.

tcm-huang-lu-qi.title: Academician, Chinese Academy of Engineering
tcm-huang-lu-qi.achievement: Medicinal plant resources and molecular pharmacognosy.
tcm-huang-lu-qi.honors: National survey of TCM resources and research on geo-authentic medicinal materials.

tcm-wang-yong-yan.title: Academician, Chinese Academy of Engineering
tcm-wang-yong-yan.achievement: TCM brain disease and stroke syndrome research.

tcm-chen-ke-ji.focus: Integrated traditional and Western medicine in cardiovascular disease, blood stasis syndrome.

tcm-wang-qi.focus: TCM constitution theory, andrology and allergic constitution regulation.

rheumatology-zhang-feng-chun.title: Chief physician, professor, doctoral supervisor
rheumatology-zhang-feng-chun.authority: Director of the Department of Internal Medicine at Peking Union Medical College Hospital; former chair of the Chinese Rheumatology Association; a driver of standardised rheumatology care in China.
rheumatology-zhang-feng-chun.focus: Systemic lupus erythematosus, rheumatoid arthritis, Sjögren's syndrome, complex autoimmune disease.
rheumatology-zhang-feng-chun.achievement: Led China's rheumatology care standards and multiple guidelines; advanced early diagnosis and individualised treatment of rheumatoid arthritis.
rheumatology-zhang-feng-chun.honors: Chinese Medical Science and Technology Award; National Advanced Worker.

rheumatology-zhao-yan.achievement: Research on systemic lupus erythematosus and Sjögren's syndrome.

rheumatology-xu-hu-ji.achievement: Ankylosing spondylitis and exploratory CAR-T therapy for rheumatic disease.
rheumatology-xu-hu-ji.honors: Research on cell therapy for autoimmune disease.

rheumatology-wu-hu-sheng.achievement: Differential diagnosis of rheumatic and osteoarticular disease.

rheumatology-bao-chun-de.focus: Systemic lupus erythematosus, complex rheumatic disease.

infectious-diseases-li-lan-juan.title: Academician, Chinese Academy of Engineering
infectious-diseases-li-lan-juan.authority: Academician of the Chinese Academy of Engineering; director of the State Key Laboratory for Diagnosis and Treatment of Infectious Diseases; an authority on artificial liver support and infectious disease in China.
infectious-diseases-li-lan-juan.focus: Liver failure and artificial liver support, emerging infectious diseases, viral hepatitis, infectious disease.
infectious-diseases-li-lan-juan.achievement: Created the artificial liver support system, significantly reducing mortality in liver failure; played a key role in controlling H7N9 and COVID-19.
infectious-diseases-li-lan-juan.honors: National Science and Technology Progress Special Award; Ho Leung Ho Lee Foundation Science and Technology Progress Award.

infectious-diseases-gao-fu.title: Academician, Chinese Academy of Sciences
infectious-diseases-gao-fu.achievement: Mechanisms of cross-species pathogen transmission and vaccine development; H7N9 origin tracing.
infectious-diseases-gao-fu.honors: Research on emerging infectious diseases and vaccines.

infectious-diseases-lu-hong-zhou.achievement: Clinical management of emerging infectious diseases and infection control.

infectious-diseases-jiang-rong-meng.achievement: Severe infection and fever of unknown origin.

infectious-diseases-chen-cheng-wei.achievement: Diagnosis and treatment of liver and infectious disease.

infectious-diseases-wang-fu-sheng.focus: Viral hepatitis, HIV/AIDS, stem cell therapy for liver disease.

infectious-diseases-zhang-wen-hong.focus: Infectious diseases, fever of unknown origin.

infectious-diseases-weng-xin-hua.focus: Fever of unknown origin, central nervous system infections.

plastic-surgery-li-qing-feng.title: Professor, chief physician, doctoral supervisor
plastic-surgery-li-qing-feng.authority: Vice president of Shanghai Ninth People's Hospital and director of plastic and reconstructive surgery; Changjiang Scholar; National Science Fund for Distinguished Young Scholars awardee; a leader in reconstructive surgery and regenerative medicine in China.
plastic-surgery-li-qing-feng.focus: Facial contouring and eye aesthetics, scar and wound repair, body surface organ reconstruction, fat grafting and regenerative medicine.
plastic-surgery-li-qing-feng.achievement: His team achieved the world's first cross-germ-layer fat regeneration, advancing the regenerative medicine paradigm; internationally leading in complex wound repair and facial reconstruction.
plastic-surgery-li-qing-feng.honors: Chinese Medical Science and Technology Progress Award; Shanghai Science and Technology Progress Award; American Sackler Foundation China Physician Award.

plastic-surgery-cao-yi-lin.achievement: Tissue-engineered cartilage and ear reconstruction; internationally leading work including the human-ear mouse model.
plastic-surgery-cao-yi-lin.honors: Research on tissue engineering and regenerative medicine.

plastic-surgery-li-fa-cheng.achievement: Liposuction and autologous fat grafting for face and breast.

plastic-surgery-wang-jia-qi.achievement: Facial and neck rejuvenation and eye aesthetics.
